LanguageData.BOR_PumpModeDesc: Choose what the pump does. Each job keeps its own progress.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_Pollution_Desc: Slowly cleans polluted terrain and forms toxic wastepacks.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_Dry_Desc: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_Wet_Desc: Very slowly unbalances moisture in nearby terrain, converting dry ground into shallow water. Does not affect sand.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_Fertilizer_Desc: Very slowly distributes fertilizer in nearby terrain, converting different soils into fertile land. Only affects farmable terrain.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_JackHammer_Desc: Shakes apart stone terrain, very slowly converting rocky areas into stony soil. Will also affect your smoothed stone floors.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_DeepWet_Desc: Very slowly brings groundwater to the surface, converting shallow water into deep water. Does not work on rivers. Has a smaller area of effect than other jobs.
LanguageData.BOR_PumpMode_Shallower_Desc: Very slowly raises lake-beds and sea-beds, converting deep water into shallow water. Has a smaller area of effect than other jobs.
